done_when: A review whose findings name files by an absolute path inside the checkout is kept, and those findings show the repo-relative path with no second review run.

known.title: Not done: Checkout paths cited through a symlink alias are discarded
Test: Checkout paths cited through a symlink alias are kept in one review

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a macOS reviewer cites the checkout using a valid different-case spelling.
The test adds the mixed-case case only when `swapped.exists()` is true, but the pull request test job runs on Ubuntu (`.github/workflows/forge.yml:61`), where the fixture creates only the lowercase worktree (`tests/test_close.py:228`). The required check therefore exercises the direct and symlink paths but not the mixed-case path. An implementation that resolves symlinks while still matching checkout prefixes case-sensitively would pass CI even though a valid mixed-case macOS path discards the review and triggers a retry. The case-insensitive part of the previous finding remains unproved.
findings.title: Test: Checkout paths cited through a symlink alias are kept in one review

why: A review finding that names a file by its absolute path makes the review helper discard the whole review, so its tokens (about 3M once) are wasted and the review runs again.
